LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_AttackRadiusBandsLegend:
Color bands (raid target pick likelihood):
Red = 0–25% of max range. Highest likelihood to pick a target.
Orange = 25–50% of max range.
Yellow = 50–75% of max range.
Pale yellow-green = 75–100% of max range. Lowest likelihood.
Under Expansionist Zeal, the innermost band shows cyan instead of red.
